question.question: 3,3-dimethylbutan-2-ol, CH3–CH(OH)–C(CH3)3, reacts with HBr. What is the major product?

lesson.title: Br kahan lagega: pehle skeleton dekho
lesson.concept: Protonation, water departure, stability-driven methyl migration and halide capture
lesson.asked: HBr ke saath major organic product kaunsa banega?
unknowns: Carbon skeleton rearrange hoga ya nahi
assumptions: Ordinary HBr substitution conditions, without deliberately promoted dehydration.
A stepwise carbocation pathway represents the expected major product.
objectives: Electron pairs aur charges track karo.
Capture se pehle carbocation stability check karo.

prerequisites.why: Direct carbon neighbours secondary aur tertiary centres ko distinguish karte hain.
Arrow lone pair ya bond se shuru hota hai.
Migration tab favourable hoti hai jab zyada stable carbocation mile.

evidence.idea: Alcohol classification OH-bearing carbon par depend karti hai.
Oxygen ka lone pair alcohol ko proton accept karne deta hai.
Protonated alcohol electrophile ki tarah carbon–oxygen bond cleavage karta hai.

lines: step protonate Oxygen accepts the acid proton and bromide forms: lp 7 -> 9; bond 9-10 -> 10
step leave Water leaves and the original alcohol carbon becomes cationic: bond 2-7 -> 7
step migrate A neighbouring methyl migrates with its bond pair to give a tertiary carbocation: shift 5 3 -> 2
step capture Bromide captures the rearranged carbocation: lp 10 -> 3
trap direct after leave Capture before checking rearrangement preserves the original skeleton: lp 10 -> 2

stages.title: Reaction centre pehchaano
stages.text: OH-bearing carbon aur branched neighbour ko alag track karo.

beats.say: Yahan HBr diya hai, aur humein major product ki connectivity pehchaanani hai.
beats.voice: यहाँ एचबीआर दिया है, और हमें मेजर प्रोडक्ट की कनेक्टिविटी पहचाननी है।

beats.say: Paas ka carbon bahut branched hai, lekin OH asal mein kis carbon par laga hai?
beats.voice: पास का कार्बन बहुत ब्रांच्ड है, लेकिन ओएच असल में किस कार्बन पर लगा है?

stages.title: Sirf OH ko Br se badalna?
stages.text: Direct replacement skeleton ko unchanged maan leta hai.

beats.say: Seedha OH hataakar Br laga dena tempting hai, par ismein skeleton unchanged maan liya gaya.
beats.voice: सीधा ओएच हटाकर बीआर लगा देना टेम्प्टिंग है, पर इसमें स्केलेटन अनचेंज्ड मान लिया गया।

beats.say: Yeh shortcut padosi carbon ke methyl ko ignore karta hai; carbocation banne par uski migration check karni hogi.
beats.voice: यह शॉर्टकट पड़ोसी कार्बन के मिथाइल को इग्नोर करता है; कार्बोकैटायन बनने पर उसकी माइग्रेशन चेक करनी होगी।

stages.title: Leaving group taiyaar karo
stages.text: Oxygen proton leta hai; neutral water nikal sakta hai.

beats.say: Oxygen ke paas electron pair hai; acid ka proton lene wala atom pehle chuno.
beats.voice: ऑक्सीजन के पास इलेक्ट्रॉन पेयर है; एसिड का प्रोटॉन लेने वाला ऐटम पहले चुनो।

beats.say: Oxygen proton leta hai aur H–Br ke bond electrons bromine par jaate hain.
beats.voice: ऑक्सीजन प्रोटॉन लेता है और एच–बीआर के बॉन्ड इलेक्ट्रॉन्स ब्रोमीन पर जाते हैं।

stages.title: Charge aur skeleton track karo
stages.text: Water departure ke baad stability check, migration aur capture.

beats.say: Carbon–oxygen bond ka pair oxygen leta hai; water nikalta hai aur carbon positive banta hai.
beats.voice: कार्बन–ऑक्सीजन बॉन्ड का पेयर ऑक्सीजन लेता है; वॉटर निकलता है और कार्बन पॉज़िटिव बनता है।

beats.say: Ab bromide bulaane se pehle dekho, padosi methyl khiske toh positive carbon zyada stable hoga?
beats.voice: अब ब्रोमाइड बुलाने से पहले देखो, पड़ोसी मिथाइल खिसके तो पॉज़िटिव कार्बन ज़्यादा स्टेबल होगा?

beats.say: Methyl apne bond pair ke saath khiskta hai; purana positive centre neutral aur padosi tertiary carbocation banta hai.
beats.voice: मिथाइल अपने बॉन्ड पेयर के साथ खिसकता है; पुराना पॉज़िटिव सेंटर न्यूट्रल और पड़ोसी टर्शियरी कार्बोकैटायन बनता है।

beats.say: Bromide ab naye positive carbon se bond banaata hai, isliye rearranged bromide major product hai.
beats.voice: ब्रोमाइड अब नए पॉज़िटिव कार्बन से बॉन्ड बनाता है, इसलिए रीअरेंज्ड ब्रोमाइड मेजर प्रोडक्ट है।

beats.say: Final structure ko dobara number karo; naam 2-bromo-2,3-dimethylbutane hai, yani option 2 sahi hai.
beats.voice: फाइनल स्ट्रक्चर को दोबारा नंबर करो; नाम 2-ब्रोमो-2,3-डाइमिथाइलब्यूटेन है, यानी ऑप्शन 2 सही है।

stages.title: Halide badlo, reasoning rakho
stages.text: Sirf HBr ki jagah HCl rakho.

beats.say: Ab sirf HBr ki jagah HCl rakho; alcohol ka carbon skeleton bilkul wahi rakhenge.
beats.voice: अब सिर्फ़ एचबीआर की जगह एचसीएल रखो; ऐल्कोहॉल का कार्बन स्केलेटन बिल्कुल वही रखेंगे।

beats.say: Khud stability check karke batao, chloride capture se pehle rearranged skeleton milega ya original skeleton?
beats.voice: खुद स्टेबिलिटी चेक करके बताओ, क्लोराइड कैप्चर से पहले रीअरेंज्ड स्केलेटन मिलेगा या ओरिजिनल स्केलेटन?

details.title: OH se water tak
details.text: Protonation oxygen ko positive banaati hai. C–O bond pair oxygen par aane se neutral water aur carbocation milte hain.
chain: Oxygen lone pair aur acidic proton

details.title: Methyl bond pair ke saath chalta hai
details.text: Initial positive carbon ke do carbon neighbours hain; migration ke baad positive neighbour ke teen carbon neighbours hain. Neighbour par hydrogen nahi hai, isliye usse hydride shift nahi hota.
chain: Methyl apne bond pair ke saath migrate

gates.prompt: OH directly kis carbon se bonded hai?

wrong.why: Nearby branching ko OH attachment samajh liya; classification directly bonded carbon se hoti hai.
Oxygen se carbon tak actual bond trace karo.

gates.why: OH-bearing carbon apne direct carbon neighbours ke hisaab se secondary hai.

gates.prompt: Acid proton ke liye electron-pair donor aur acceptor chuno.

wrong.why: Proton electron-pair donor nahi hai; arrow oxygen ke lone pair se shuru hoga.
Alcohol oxygen pair deta hai aur acid hydrogen use accept karta hai.

gates.why: O–H bond banta hai aur H–Br bond pair bromide ko milta hai.

gates.prompt: Water departure ke baad major pathway ke liye kya check karoge?
choices: Methyl shift se secondary ki jagah tertiary carbocation
Seedha capture; skeleton badal hi nahi sakta
Neighbour se hydride shift bina hydrogen check kiye

wrong.why: Available stability-improving rearrangement ko ignore kiya gaya hai.
Branched neighbour par hydrogen nahi hai, isliye usse hydride migrate nahi kar sakta.

gates.why: Methyl migration secondary carbocation ko tertiary carbocation mein badalti hai.

gates.prompt: Migration ke baad bromide kis carbon ko capture karega?

wrong.why: Original OH-carbon neutral ho chuka hai; positive charge neighbour par hai.
Nucleophile current positive centre ko electron pair deta hai.

gates.why: Bromide ka lone pair carbocation se bond banaakar charge neutral karta hai.

gates.prompt: Isi alcohol ke saath HCl ho toh expected major chloride ka skeleton?
choices: Rearranged skeleton, chloride naye tertiary centre par
Original skeleton, kyunki chloride migration rokta hai

wrong.why: Halide badalne se stability-improving methyl migration ki structural opportunity khatam nahi hoti.

gates.why: Same stability check chloride capture se pehle bhi rearranged carbocation deta hai.

board.note: Oxygen proton leta hai; oxygen positive aur bromide negative banta hai.
C–O pair oxygen leta hai; water aur secondary carbocation bante hain.
Methyl bond pair migrate karta hai; tertiary carbocation milta hai.
Bromide naye positive centre se bond banaata hai.

diagnoses.title: Unrearranged replacement
diagnoses.why: OH ko Br se replace karke stability-improving methyl migration skip ki.

diagnoses.title: Migration aur capture
diagnoses.why: Methyl migration tertiary carbocation deti hai, jise bromide capture karta hai.

diagnoses.title: Elimination ko major chuna
diagnoses.why: Alkene pathway ko expected HBr substitution product ki jagah major maan liya.

diagnoses.title: Arbitrary terminal attachment
diagnoses.why: Terminal carbon par bromine bhejne ka supported electron-pair pathway nahi hai.

families.title: Migrating group tracking
families.question: Marked methyl ki final attachment kis original carbon par hogi?
families.why: Methyl apne bond pair ke saath original carbocation centre par migrate karta hai.

families.title: Different hydrogen halide
families.question: Sirf HBr ko HCl se badalne par expected major product kaunsa hai?
families.why: Methyl migration ka stability gain bana rehta hai; chloride rearranged carbocation ko capture karta hai.

lesson.recap: Protonation, water departure, stability check, methyl migration aur bromide capture: major product 2-bromo-2,3-dimethylbutane, option 2.
limitations: Supplied blocks support classification, proton acceptance and protonated-alcohol C–O cleavage, but do not explicitly cover HBr substitution or carbocation rearrangements.
The model explains expected connectivity, not rates, solvent effects or product percentages.
Equivalent neighbouring methyl groups can migrate; one mapped representative is shown.
Distractors without suitable supported pathways are diagnosed without invented arrows.

problems: stage trap: 1 beats; it needs at least 2
stage solve beat 4: focus a3-a10 are not parts of the model (a1, a1-a2, a10, a11, a2, a2-a11, a2-a3, a2-a7, a3, a3-a4, a3-a5, a3-a6...)
stage transfer: 1 beats; it needs at least 2

protonate.label: Oxygen accepts the acid proton and bromide forms

leave.label: Water leaves and the original alcohol carbon becomes cationic

migrate.label: A neighbouring methyl migrates with its bond pair to give a tertiary carbocation
